_comment_about_this_file: This is a template for a batch manifest. Copy this file to prompts/queue/{batch_id}/manifest.json in a product repository and fill in the values. Remove the _comment_* fields when filling in.
_comment_schema_evolution: Backward-compatibility rule for this schema. New fields added in future versions of this template MUST be optional and have a documented default value behavior in the routine prompt. Required-field additions are a breaking change: they invalidate every existing manifest in every product repository (e.g. the completed batch-2026-05-11-repo-foundation manifest in ai-knowledge-system). A breaking change requires (a) bumping the major version of this template, (b) a paired update of templates/batch-execution/routine-prompt.md to handle both schemas during the transition, (c) explicit Vasily approval, (d) a documented migration plan for existing manifests. In practice: prefer adding optional fields with sensible defaults. Older manifests omitting the field continue to work; newer manifests opt in by setting the field explicitly. This matches the best-practice schema evolution rule for JSON-shaped contracts consumed by multiple clients (the Routine and every planning chat that composes a manifest).
_comment_batch_id: Unique identifier. Format: batch-DATE-purpose. Example: batch-2026-05-08-design-system-finish. Must match folder name under prompts/queue/.
title: Human-readable batch title
_comment_title: Short description shown in Telegram start message and logs.
_comment_created_by: Who composed the batch. Usually Claude.ai (planning chat) or Vasily.
_comment_created_at: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was committed to the repository.
_comment_completed_at: ISO 8601 timestamp when batch finished. Null until completion. Updated by routine.
_comment_stop_on_failure: If true, batch stops on first failed prompt. If false, batch continues with remaining prompts. Default: true (recommended for pilots and any batch where prompts depend on each other).
_comment_telegram_notify: If true, send Telegram messages on start, each prompt completion, and batch end. Default: true.
_comment_inter_prompt_wait_minutes: Minutes to wait after each prompt push before health check. Allows auto-merge and deploy to complete. Default: 10. Only override if the product's deploy pipeline is consistently faster or slower.
_comment_health_url_override: Optional override for HEALTH_URL env variable. Use null to use the routine's environment value. Useful when one batch needs to check a different endpoint than the default (e.g. staging vs production).

prompts._comment_about_prompts: Array of prompts to execute in order. Each prompt is a separate file under prompts/queue/{batch_id}/.
prompts.title: Short title in English (2-5 words)

_comment_prompt_status_values: Allowed status values: pending (not yet started), running (currently executing), done (completed successfully), failed (execution failed or health check returned bad state), unverified (health check could not run for reasons unrelated to system state, e.g. network error or egress denial — batch continues, never stops on this status), skipped (skipped due to earlier failure when stop_on_failure was true).
_comment_prompt_id_format: Sequential two-digit number starting from 01. Matches the file prefix.
_comment_prompt_file_format: Filename relative to prompts/queue/{batch_id}/. Format: {id}-{kebab-case-title}.md. Example: 01-create-health-endpoint.md.
_comment_prompt_title_format: Same as the title header inside the prompt file. 2-5 words in English. Used in Telegram messages and commit messages.
